themeCards.title: The official 30-year yield rose to 5.59%
themeCards.fact: US Treasury: the official 29 September curve printed 4.89% on the 2-year, 5.06% on the 5-year, 5.26% on the 10-year, and 5.59% on the 30-year, after 4.92%, 5.06%, 5.24%, and 5.56% on 28 September.
themeCards.mechanism: The 30-year rose from 5.56% to 5.59% while the 2-year fell from 4.92% to 4.89%, so the long end made another high and the front end eased. CICC (24 August): a higher long-end US yield reaches shares through cross-border flows and risk mood, and the link is uneven. USTs, US equities, and the dollar carry this higher long end. The theme changes if the official 30-year reprints at or below 5.56%.

themeCards.title: Brent settled at 102.59 after exports recovered
themeCards.fact: Reuters: Brent settled down 2.69, or 2.6%, at 102.59, and WTI settled down 3.22, or 3.5%, at 89.38. Saudi Arabia resumed tanker loadings at Yanbu after the East-West pipeline restarted.
themeCards.mechanism: The settle at 102.59 came after the East-West pipeline restarted, so recovered export flow pulled the price down. CICC (21 September): with inventories lower than before, the oil price can still swing widely. Oil carries the 102.59 settle. The theme changes if a later Brent settle reprints at or above 102.59.
themeCards.invalidator: A later Brent settle at or above 102.59.

themeCards.title: A first-home subsidy and a cheaper PSL rate are now priced
themeCards.fact: 新华财经: Shanghai closed at 3,830.45, up 0.18%, on 29 September. 第一财经: the one-year PSL rate was cut by 0.25 percentage points, from 1.75% to 1.5%, and the tech and equipment relending quota rose by 2000亿元. 财新: from 1 October, a qualifying first-home loan gets a subsidy of 1 percentage point.

factSources.label: 第一财经 货币工具

themeCards.mechanism: The subsidy and the cheaper PSL rate landed together, so the policy response now has a start date and a price. CICC (30 September): the mortgage subsidy helps payment ability and local price expectations in some cities, and does less in the largest cities. A-shares carry that package against the 3,830.45 close. The theme changes if the one-year PSL rate is put back to 1.75%.
themeCards.trigger: The 1 October subsidy starts and the one-year PSL rate stays at 1.5%.
themeCards.invalidator: The one-year PSL rate going back to 1.75%.

themeCards.title: Consumer confidence fell to a 12-year low
themeCards.fact: Conference Board: the consumer confidence index fell by 6.7 points to 81.9 in September, from 88.6 in August. The Present Situation Index fell by 7.9 points to 109.3, and the Expectations Index fell by 5.9 points to 63.6.
themeCards.mechanism: Both parts of the index fell, the present situation by 7.9 points and expectations by 5.9 points to 63.6, so the chart is a broad household cooling. 财经早茶 (30 September): job openings fell to a five-month low while layoffs stayed low, which shows the cooling in hiring demand. US equities carry that cooler household print. The theme changes if a later Conference Board index reprints at or above 88.6.
themeCards.trigger: A later Conference Board index at or below 81.9.
themeCards.invalidator: A later Conference Board index at or above 88.6.

globalImplies.text: If the long end stays at the new high, borrowing costs stay tight into PCE and the employment report even if the front end eases.
If the Yanbu restart holds and November quotas stay put, the oil giveback can extend. A wide swing is still what the lower inventory leaves open.
If households stay at the September confidence low, the equity tape keeps digesting a weaker spending mood beside the long-end high.

globalTensions: The 30-year rose and the 2-year fell on the same official curve. Oil settled lower while the mail had gold rebounding and copper slightly higher on a Chile strike vote. US stocks drifted down while the mail had the dollar at a two-month high. Confidence fell hard while Williams still described the labor market as solid enough to live with a later hike.
